title: Automation Health GitHub workflow pagination repair
objective: Make Automation Production Health enumerate the complete GitHub Actions workflow registry instead of only the first 100 workflows, so workflows beyond page one are not falsely classified as WORKFLOW_NOT_REGISTERED_OR_API_UNAVAILABLE or NO_RUN_HISTORY and do not mature into spurious CODEX_READY tasks.

evidence.summary: live_workflows calls actions/workflows?per_page=100 once and does not request additional pages.
The latest observed artifact reports 112 local workflows but exactly 100 registered workflows, matching the GitHub API page size ceiling.
shadow-registry-weekly.yml has matured to CODEX_READY for NO_RUN_HISTORY while the same health family also reports multiple newer workflows as WORKFLOW_NOT_REGISTERED_OR_API_UNAVAILABLE.
The workflow is a valid scheduled main writer with explicit Europe/Copenhagen timezone, so registry truncation must be excluded before task-specific code changes are attempted.

forbidden_changes: workflow schedules unrelated to health observation
hardcoding workflow names to avoid pagination
reproduction: Run Automation Health against a GitHub workflow registry containing more than 100 workflows, with at least one valid local scheduled workflow returned only on API page 2. Current live_workflows fetches only actions/workflows?per_page=100, so that workflow has live=null and is classified as WORKFLOW_NOT_REGISTERED_OR_API_UNAVAILABLE and, if scheduled, NO_RUN_HISTORY. The current production artifact independently shows 112 local workflows but exactly 100 registered workflows.

positive: A mocked registry with 112 workflows is fully enumerated across GitHub API pages and registered_workflow_count becomes 112.
A workflow appearing only on page 2 receives its real live metadata and is not assigned WORKFLOW_NOT_REGISTERED_OR_API_UNAVAILABLE solely because of pagination.
Per-workflow run-history retrieval continues to preserve failure_streak, success_streak, latest run and lifecycle semantics for page-2 workflows.
Fresh production health no longer shows an artificial 100-workflow registration ceiling.
negative: A genuinely missing local workflow still receives WORKFLOW_NOT_REGISTERED_OR_API_UNAVAILABLE.
GitHub API failure on a later page must not silently report a partial registry as complete or fabricate GREEN state.
Pagination must terminate deterministically on an empty or short page and must not loop indefinitely.
The repair must not weaken RED classifications for real failed, stale, unsafe or unregistered workflows.

clean_noop_condition: Fresh main already paginates the GitHub workflow registry completely and a production health run reports all local registered workflows without a 100-item ceiling.
stop_condition: Stop without code changes if the reproduction no longer holds or if the required repair extends beyond health observation and its tests.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER only if complete workflow enumeration cannot be achieved with the existing GitHub Actions read permission and API surface.
rollback_plan: Revert only the bounded health pagination code/tests. Do not alter workflow schedules or historical health artifacts.
